<div class="content__wrapper">
      <div class="grid__container"><h1>Swiss Kitesurf ♡ Kiloashara</h1></div>
<div class="inhalt__wrapper">
  <div class="grid__container">
    <div class="inhalt__text">
      <p><strong>Don't let winter take hold just yet - </strong></p>
<p>keep the summer vibes and come kitesurfing with us in the beautiful Red Sea in Egypt! </p>
<p>Perfect wind, endless space and the bluest water you've ever seen.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
<article class="actionbanner__section">
    <section class="actionbanner__wrapper">
        <div class="col-2">
            &nbsp;
        </div>
        <div class="col-7">
            <div class="actionbanner__content" data-sal="slide-right" data-sal-duration="500" data-sal-easing="ease-in-out">
                <h3 class="actionbanner__title">When?</h3>
                <p class="actionbanner__text">3. - 10.10 / 10. - 17.10 / 17. - 24.10 / 24. - 31.10 / 31.10 - 7.11</p>
            </div>
        </div>
                        <div class="col-3">
                <div class="actionbanner__button" data-sal="slide-left" data-sal-duration="500" data-sal-easing="ease-in-out">
                                        <a class="actionbanner__button--link" href="https://kitesailing.ch/en/kite-camp-booking-request" >
                        <span class="button button--invers button--small">Book now!<i class="icon-right-open"></i></span>
                    </a>
                </div>
            </div>
    </section>
</article>
<div class="inhalt__wrapper">
  <div class="grid__container">
    <div class="inhalt__text">
      <p><strong>Would you like to escape the winter and extend the summer season?</strong> Join us in Soma Bay, Egypt, for an unforgettable kite camp in the fall of 2026! Whether you're a complete beginner or an experienced kitesurfer, we have something for everyone!</p>
<p>✨ <strong>This is included:</strong></p>
<ul><li><strong>Transfers</strong>: We take care of your arrival and departure.</li><li><strong>Accommodation</strong>: 7 nights in a simple, cozy hotel (double or single rooms available).</li><li><strong>Meals</strong>: Enjoy delicious meals during your stay (full board).</li><li><strong>Kite Station</strong>: Right next to the hotel is the kite station with storage room, rescue equipment, and compressor.</li><li><strong>Rescue</strong>: All rescues included if you happen to get a bit too excited.</li><li><strong>Explore</strong>: Excursion to Safaga with a local guide.</li><li><strong>80% Wind Probability</strong>.</li><li>Plenty of time to relax, sleep, eat, and soak up the sun.</li>
</ul>
<p>&#x1f32c;️ <strong>Great wind conditions &amp; amazing vibes guaranteed!</strong> Whether you're just starting or perfecting your tricks, we offer expert guidance in a relaxed, fun atmosphere. Freeriders are also welcome – bring your own gear or use ours!</p>
<p>✈️ <strong>Flights and visa:</strong> These need to be arranged by yourself, but we’re happy to help you find the best options!</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
  <article class="inhalt__element">
    <div class="grid__container">
      <div class="inhalt__wrapper--bild align--bildRechts bildgroesse-small">
        <div class="bild__wrapper">
          <img
      data-src="https://kitesailing.ch/assets/img/Camps/lost-lagoon-schulung.png"
              alt="Lost lagoon schulung"
            class="lazyload"
    />
        </div>
          <div class="text__wrapper">
            <h3>For beginners or anyone who wants to improve their skills</h3>
            <p>&#x1f3c4;‍♀️ <strong>Lessons for All Levels:</strong></p>
<ul><li><strong>Full board and accommodation in a double room</strong></li><li><strong>Beginners, intermediate, or advanced</strong> – we offer lessons for all experience levels.</li><li><strong>Semi-private lessons (2-1)</strong>: Get tailored instruction focused on your personal progression.</li>
<li><strong>5 x </strong><strong>3 hours lessons per day</strong> in <strong>German or English</strong>.</li>
<li>Once you’re independent, you can use the equipment at any time!</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>CHF 1750.- in shared room (only bookable in pairs)<br /></strong><strong>+ CHF 300.- single room surcharge</strong></p>
          </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </article>
  <article class="inhalt__element">
    <div class="grid__container">
      <div class="inhalt__wrapper--bild align-- bildgroesse-small">

              alt="Lost lagoon 2"
            class="lazyload"
    />
        </div>
          <div class="text__wrapper">
            <h3>For independent kiters who need equipment:</h3>
            <p>&#x1fa81;<strong> </strong><strong>Save yourself the stress of excess baggage and rent your equipment directly at the station!</strong></p>
<ul><li><strong>Full board and accommodation in a double room</strong></li><li>Complete equipment rental for the entire week.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>CHF 1350.- <strong>in shared room (only bookable in pairs)<br /></strong><strong>+ CHF 300.- single room surcharge</strong></strong></p>
          </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </article>
  <article class="inhalt__element">
    <div class="grid__container">
      <div class="inhalt__wrapper--bild align--bildRechts bildgroesse-small">
        <div class="bild__wrapper">

      data-src="https://kitesailing.ch/assets/img/Camps/_600xAUTO_crop_bottom-right_80_none/Lost-lagoon-3.jpg"
              alt="Lost lagoon 3"
            class="lazyload"
    />
        </div>
          <div class="text__wrapper">
            <h3>For independent kiters who bring their own equipment</h3>
            <p><strong>&#x1f6cf;️ Do you only need a bed, food and a pump?</strong></p>
<ul><li><strong>Full board and accommodation in a double room only</strong></li></ul>
<p><strong>CHF 950.- <strong>in shared room (only bookable in pairs)<br /></strong><strong>+ CHF 300.- single room surcharge</strong></strong></p>
          </div>

  <article class="inhalt__element">
    <div class="grid__container">
      <div class="inhalt__wrapper--bild align-- bildgroesse-small">
        <div class="bild__wrapper">
          <img
      data-src="https://kitesailing.ch/assets/img/teambilder/_600xAUTO_crop_bottom-right_80_none/69332/WhatsApp-Image-2025-01-19-at-16.50.17.jpg"
              alt="Whats App Image 2025 01 19 at 16 50 17"
            class="lazyload"
    />
        </div>
          <div class="text__wrapper">
            <h3>Your tour guide</h3>
            <p>Hello everyone! I’m Stef(fi), and I’ve been teaching for 15 years, mostly in Silvaplana, but also in various random places around the world &#x1f30d;- <a href="https://www.kitesailing.ch/team/stef" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">This is me</a><br />I’ve been heading to Soma Bay several times a year since 2011 ✈️. I go so often, I’m pretty sure the camels are starting to recognize me &#x1f42a;! But there’s a reason I keep returning to this spot over and over. It’s just a short flight, the wind is super reliable &#x1f32c;️, the water is warm &#x1f30a;, the locals are incredibly friendly &#x1f60a;, and let’s not forget, the food is pretty amazing too &#x1f37d;️. So, I’d love to invite you to join me for a kite camp this autumn &#x1f342; – extend the summer, delay the winter ❄️. Who knows, maybe you'll end up loving it there as much as I do! ❤️<br /></p>
          </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </article>
  <article class="inhalt__element">
    <div class="grid__container">
      <div class="inhalt__wrapper--bild align--bildRechts bildgroesse-small">
        <div class="bild__wrapper">
          <img
      data-src="https://kitesailing.ch/assets/img/teambilder/_600xAUTO_crop_bottom-right_80_none/69454/Michi.jpg"
              alt="Michi"
            class="lazyload"
    />
        </div>
          <div class="text__wrapper">
            <h3>The entertainer</h3>
            <p>Meet Michi, our all-rounder and ultimate entertainer &#x1f3a4;! He’ll be joining us in Egypt and, trust me, his infectious energy will keep you smiling and laughing all night long &#x1f604;. Whether he’s leading a group, sharing a laugh, or just keeping the good vibes flowing, Michi has a way of making every moment more fun and enjoyable.</p>
<p>And when it comes to kiting, he’s not just about the laughs—Michi is an incredible kiter &#x1f3c4;‍♂️! Whether you're a beginner or want to improve your skills, he can teach you just about anything and make sure you’re having a blast while doing it. &#x1f30a;</p>
          </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </article>
  <article class="inhalt__element">
    <div class="grid__container">
      <div class="inhalt__wrapper--bild align--bildLinks bildgroesse-small">
        <div class="bild__wrapper">
          <img
      data-srcset="
          https://kitesailing.ch/assets/img/_600xAUTO_crop_bottom-right_80_none/83284/Chris-profil-bild.jpg 600w,          https://kitesailing.ch/assets/img/_1200xAUTO_crop_bottom-right_80_none/83284/Chris-profil-bild.jpg 1200w        "
      data-src="https://kitesailing.ch/assets/img/_600xAUTO_crop_bottom-right_80_none/83284/Chris-profil-bild.jpg"
              alt="Chris profil bild"
            class="lazyload"
    />
        </div>
          <div class="text__wrapper">
            <h3>The calm in the storm</h3>
            <p>Meet Chris, one of our long-standing instructors in Silvaplana. This 
year, he’s joining us in Egypt for the first time — mostly to teach, and
 partly to make sure the rest of us don’t completely spiral out of 
control. &#x1f604;</p>
<p>Chris is a fantastic instructor with an incredibly patient and 
methodical approach to teaching. He breaks everything down step by step,
 explains things slowly and clearly, and makes sure you really 
understand what you’re doing before moving on to the next challenge.</p>
<p>It’s probably no coincidence that so many of his students have 
enjoyed his lessons so much that they’ve begged to continue with Chris 
and Chris only. Once you’ve got him, apparently, you don’t want to let 
him go!</p>
<p>And then there’s his wonderfully dry sense of humour. Expect 
perfectly timed one-liners, the occasional raised eyebrow, and just 
enough sarcasm to keep things entertaining — especially when your kite 
has other plans. &#x1f609;<br /></p>
          </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </article>
